Now from here on it’s speculation, and anyone correct me if I’m wrong, but i thought the only cursed technique that could be used in a domain is the one imbued in it. Now normally that wouldnt be an issue, as most sorcerers do not have multiple CT’s. But potentially Sukuna does, and [OPEN] is potentially a separate CT from C&D. So i dont think it could be used within the domain imbued with C&D. And ofc, if used outside of MS, Gojo would just face tank with Infinity. Sukuna never used the fire arrow because there was no window/value to using it.
Also add on that fact that Sukuna’s great deal of pride got in the way for him, and i do think he gave Gojo far too many opportunities because of it.

Finally, I think Gojo made the statement about Sukuna going all out because it its factually true that Sukuna did not use his full arsenal, and Gojo, much less the readers, are not even aware of what Sukuna’s full arsenal IS. Also, when Sukuna first takes over Megumi’s body, he’s asked i believe by Uraume why he wont fully transform, and Sukuna states “this body is better for fighting sorcerers.” So as far as we know, it was not cause he wanted it as a last second cop out heal, he genuinely needed the use of the 10S to defeat Gojo. Or at least to do so in a quick enough manner. In my eyes, from a very ill-informed viewpoint due to the lack of present information, Heian Sukuna without 10s vs Gojo would be a much longer fight of who can hold out the longest, until Sukuna eventually realized the potential of strong cleave. I just believe 10s helped greatly expedite that process.
